name: Why Diapers, Anyway?
source:
Why diapers, anyway?

Some of you may have asked that same question when you first learn that this interest exists.

If it seems especially odd to you that after someone outgrows the need for diapers in infancy and young childhood, that they would actually desire to continue wearing or using them, you're not alone. But even if it seems strange to you, enjoyment of diapers is something that happens even among teens and adults. The phenomenon seems to be increasing in popularity, or at least open discussion, as the years go by.

While each individual has their own reasons for enjoying diapers, be they known or unknown to the mind, I can only speak to my own experiences. Allow me to share them with you here. Perhaps they can help you come to some new levels of understanding about yourself, or someone you know who may be in a similar situation.

[From [url=https://phoenixgr.itch.io/why-diapers-anyway]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为什么会有人喜欢纸尿裤？

刚听说这种兴趣时，你或许也问过同样的问题。

如果你觉得人长大、脱离婴幼儿时期后，竟还会想继续穿戴或使用纸尿裤，实在很奇怪，那你并不孤单。但即使你觉得这很奇怪，青少年和成年人中也确实有人喜欢纸尿裤。随着时间推移，这种现象似乎越来越普遍，至少也更常被公开讨论。

每个人喜欢纸尿裤的原因都不一样，有些自己也说不清楚。在这里，我只能分享自己的经历。希望这些内容能帮你更了解自己，或了解身边有类似经历的人。

[来源：[url=https://phoenixgr.itch.io/why-diapers-anyway]itch.io[/url]]
